messages:
jared: Quick idea  tiny Sunday pool called 'Buzzer Beer'  3 small prop bets, $5 entry, winner gets a silly trophy (and bragging rights). Loser brings snacks next week. :beers: :trophy:

emily: I'm in. Which props?

jared: Thinking: (1) First score type (TD/FG/Safety) (2) Longest play over/under 30 yards (3) Coin flip on OT. 2 points each correct, first-to-5 wins the pot.

rachel: Love the brevity. $5 Venmo to @jared? Also, can we do a GIF-forfeit? Loser has to post one celebratory GIF every Monday for two weeks.

tom: GIF rule accepted. But it must be SFW and labeled "Buzzer Beer shame". :grinning:

sam: Can we add a fun tiebreaker: predict combined score to the nearest 3 points. Closest wins tie.

jared: Done. Picks lock 15min before kickoff. I'll collect Venmo and post the spreadsheet.

emily: Spreadsheet please. I will also demand a ceremonial toast (nonalcoholic ok) if I win.

jared: Sheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/BUZZER_BEER_POOL (DM invites). Columns: name, prop1, prop2, prop3, tiebreaker, venmo_txn, notes.

tom: Calendar please? I need a reminder or I'll forget and show up with nothing.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Buzzer Beer: office prop pool" on 2026-03-07 13:00 PT. Reminder 30m prior. Invited: jared, emily, rachel, tom, sam.

emily: Also: house rule that if someone drafts fantasy-style and forgets to submit picks, auto-pick is 'safe bet' (FG, under 30, no OT) and they're still liable for $5.

rachel: Harsh but fair. No freeloading.

jared: For a tiny bit of drama, I'm going to add a randomized draft order for future pools. Tiny python snippet for anyone who wants to replicate:
```python
import random
players = ['jared','emily','rachel','tom','sam']
order = random.sample(players, len(players))
print(order)
```

tom: If I get first pick I'm putting it all on the coin flip. High risk, higher memes.

sam: Venmo sent @jared. Good luck, don't bully the interns. :sweat_smile:

emily: Reminder: keep it friendly, keep the volume down in the common area after 9pm, and clean up fryer grease. Also, small vegetarian option please.

jared: Noted. Final checklist: spreadsheet up, $5 Venmo to @jared or cash, picks locked 15m before kickoff, GIF-forfeit, and calendar event exists. Anything else?

rachel: Can someone make a 600x200 "Buzzer Beer" banner? I'll slap it on the fridge. :art:

jared: I'll whip a quick one after lunch. Closing thread unless objections. May the most mediocre strategist win. :tada:
